notes: Proposed 2026-10-15 from the plan's navy / teal / warm off-white direction. Confirm or adjust on the first /career-build, then set approved: true.
usage: Navy is the background, off-white is for text, teal is for accents and shapes. Don't put off-white text on teal, because the contrast is too low for WCAG AA. Warning, error and success are only for UI state indicators.

mono.use: Terminal, code and file names only

motion.notes: Channel motion language, proposed 2026-10-23 with the motion-art-direction skill: friendly and clear, lively but never busy. Every video uses these values. Change them only with the channel owner.
motion.transitions: Camera moves inside one shared world (pan, push-in, pull-out) plus short crossfades. No wipes, spins, glitches or shader transitions.
rules: One hero per moment. At most about a third of the elements move at the same time.
Overshoot (the pop ease) only on stickers, cards, ticks, icons and character beats. Never on numbers, charts or facts.
Something visibly changes every 5–8 s: a push-in, a camera move, a new element or a UI state change.
One 'wow' moment per video, on the payoff scene.
Keep the world alive but quiet: hands breathe, the cursor blinks, slow parallax.
Hold text still while it is being read; don't loop-animate it.
